gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its lines steady and tidy throughout. Capture Smallz does the raw, big-bodied lowercase swagger, while Funnel Sans handles the tidy, level strokes and the pried-open e that make a plain sans easy to follow.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-gafata: Gafata stands in a tall band with short stalks above. Capture Smallz brings a raw, tactical bulk up top, and below it the wide-eyed e shapes let a longer passage move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-geist: Raw and tactical up top, quietly level below, with Geist keeping every word a solid block. Its stroke connections run full width, so the body text can stay modest in size.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-georama: Big-bodied lowercase letters give Capture Smallz its raw, tactical look. That bulk is what it does best, while Georama's pulled-apart c and barely rising capitals handle the quieter, approachable work of the sans.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like a neon tube, with terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades. And its monoline consistency is the pair's strongest quality, set against the raw, big-bodied lowercase of Capture Smallz.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-golos-text: Capture Smallz is all big-bodied lowercase, raw and tactical, set against Golos Text, whose round letters carry no stress axis tilt. Its tall x-height fills the line nicely.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hedvig-lett: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable, its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, with a wide gap where each c ends. And Capture Smallz sits above in raw, tactical display form, giving the two a clear division of jobs.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-heebo: Heebo reads as a tall central band of text, its curves stopping short instead of closing in. Capture Smallz is best at raw, big-bodied impact; Heebo is best at quiet clarity.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hind-guntur: Big-bodied lowercase letters make Capture Smallz feel raw and tactical at a glance. And Hind Guntur's curves match its stems in thickness, so its tall, stamped-metal forms keep the pair firmly grounded.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hind-madura: Capture Smallz hits raw and tactical with big-bodied lowercase letters. Hind Madurai then follows with flat, unmodulated strokes and wide-open s curves, so a longer passage moves along in a smooth, steady ribbon.
